name: Pension Scheme for State Agitators Other Than Category of Agitators Who Went to Jail for 7 Days or got Injured during the Uttarakhand State Movement
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an identified state agitator, excluding those who were jailed for seven days or injured during the Uttarakhand state movement. 1. The applicant must not be entitled to an agitational pension or any other pension from a government source. 1. The applicant must not be employed in any government service.
